TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our AI control team. It evaluates the trusted monitor that scores pull requests from an untrusted AI agent for covert sabotage, such as a hidden backdoor or a disabled check. The team uses it to measure how much sabotage the monitor catches within a fixed audit budget, and the numbers feed into the safety case for the next agent deployment.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package evaluates a trusted monitor in an AI-control setting: an untrusted AI agent submits pull requests, some of which contain covert sabotage (a hidden backdoor or a disabled check), and the monitor gives each diff a suspicion score.
